Title: Generally Available: New Built-In Role for Azure Chaos Studio

Body.Content:
A Chaos Studio Target Contributor can onboard targets and manage capabilities in Chaos Studio but cannot create, run, or see details for experiments.

You may use this role alongside other Azure built-in roles for Chaos Studio (Chaos Studio Experiment Contributor, Chaos Studio Operator, Chaos Studio Reader) to properly manage access to Chaos Studio for users within your organization.


Learn more.
